title: Continuation and missing work
summary: Continue QUIC from dev4 by live-qualifying stream-count backpressure, then strengthening stream I/O backpressure, interoperability and migration while preserving the common socket authority.
invariants: First rerun the complete ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196/native qualification for dev4; do not promote static evidence into live status.
Add structured nonblocking stream read/write outcomes so SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ and SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE remain retryable QUIC flow-control states rather than generic failure.
Add external COTS QUIC interoperability evidence; loopback alone is not cross-implementation proof.
Add connection migration/path-change support only behind the provider boundary and preserve address/object authority.
Do not move HTTP/3 semantics into the socket provider; HTTP/3 is a separate protocol consumer of QUIC.
